Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Garrett
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 515 as introduced would provide an annual automatic cost-of-living adjustment to the retirement benefit, in the amount of 1% of the gross benefit, to each Tier II plan member who first begins eligible employment with a Teachers Retirement System (TRS) or an Employees Retirement System (ERS) participating employer on or after October 1, 2022, if the member completes at least 30 years of creditable service.
According to the actuary of the Retirement Systems of Alabama, this bill would not impact the unfunded liability of either system, as any change would be funded in the normal employer rate, beginning with FY 2024 valuations which establish the FY 2027 rates, which would increase by 1 basis point annually, up to 0.22% and 0.16%, for TRS and ERS respectively, to account for the benefit provided by the provisions of this bill.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
